Maya (Finance): Quick flag: Keystone Health called out the renewal invoice. Looks like platform fee duplicated because their multi-year addendum was billed in addition instead of replacing the original line. Can someone confirm? :grimacing:
Liam (Accounting): Put the invoice number here and Ill pull the entries.
Maya (Finance): INV-2026-3317. Copy of invoice lines:
```
INV-2026-3317
Line 1: PRIVATE_PLATFORM_FEE 01/01/2026 - 01/01/2027 $120,000
Line 2: PLATFORM_FEE_ADDENDUM_2026 01/01/2026 - 01/01/2027 $120,000
Line 3: HARDWARE_RESERVE (prorated) $8,500
Tax: $11,300
Total: $259,800
```
Maya (Finance): Contractually the addendum should have superseded the base fee for year 1. Also the HW reserve shouldn't apply per clause 4.b when addendum is active.
Olga (Customer Success): They signed addendum A-KE-2026-MYA on 2026-01-02 (doc in CS repo). Invoice dated 2026-01-05 — smells like concurrent workflow issue. Customer upset, they emailed AP.
Sam (Enterprise Sales): Confirming: addendum replaces base fee for first year and then steps down. Ill attach the signed addendum PDF to the ticket. We should credit duplicate platform fee and remove reserve charge.
Ben (Ops): Ops recommendation: do not void/reissue invoice to avoid AP reconciliation headaches. Issue a credit memo referencing INV-2026-3317 and provide corrected pro-forma if customer needs it.
Liam (Accounting): Agreed. Ill need GL mappings and customer PO for the credit entry. Maya, can you confirm exact credit amounts (including tax adjust)?
Maya (Finance): Recommend crediting $120,000 platform fee + $8,500 hardware reserve + estimated tax delta $6,600 = ~$135,100. Will finalize tax once accounting confirms jurisdictional calc.
Sam (Enterprise Sales): Approved to credit up to $140,000 to cover rounding/tax. Please include a one-line reason on the memo: "Addendum executed 2026-01-02 supersedes base platform fee."
Liam (Accounting): OK. Ill post credit memo then run closing journal. ETA to post: 48 hours after final sign-off.
Olga (Customer Success): PO is PO-77899 (attached in CS folder). Ill prepare the customer note: apology + corrected invoice details + timing for credit. Customer wants confirmation before COB Friday.
Maya (Finance): Creating billing ticket and draft credit memo now. billing-bot, create a ticket for this.
billing-bot: Created ticket B-4521 "Keystone Health duplicate platform fee & hardware reserve - credit memo request". Owner: Maya (Finance). SLA: 5 business days.
Ben (Ops): Also propose a short-term fix: block simultaneous renewal + addendum invoices if execution dates are within 7 days. Ill open an infra ticket for billing workflow.
Maya (Finance): Adding that follow-up to B-4521.
Liam (Accounting): After credit posts Ill share the GL reversal: debit PLAT-FEE-REV, credit AR, reference INV-2026-3317 & B-4521.
Olga (Customer Success): Ill notify the customer with the credit memo number once posted.
Maya (Finance): Thanks everyone. Prioritizing; will update ticket with memo number when posted. :thumbsup:
